title: One call coordinates three classes
purpose: Explain facade client call delegates to existing package classes in order.
alt: 두 클라이언트의 doSomething 호출을 파사드가 세 패키지의 클래스 작업으로 조율하는 예시
requiredChecks: Client1 and Client2 both call Facade.doSomething().
Facade uses Class1 in package1, Class2 in package2, Class3 in package3.
Facade orchestration creates c1/c2/c3, calls c1.doStuff(c2), then c3.setX(c1.getX()), then returns c3.getY().
The clients do not directly coordinate the three subsystem classes.
